question_text: A 34-year-old male presents to clinic today complaining that his medication has stopped working. He states despite being able to manage the side effects, a voice has returned again telling him to hurt his Mother. You prescribe him a drug which has shown improved efficacy in treating his disorder but requires frequent followup visits. One week later he returns with the following lab results: WBC : 2500 cells/mcL, Neutrophils : 55% and, Bands : 1%. What drug was this patient prescribed?
